name: Amani Solitaire Ring
short_description: An emerald-cut white topaz on a pavé band in 18k gold vermeil. Our most-loved engagement-style ring.
description: Amani (peace) sets a 7 x 5 mm emerald-cut white topaz in a four-claw basket, on a slim band lined with hand-set pavé stones. It is cast in sterling silver and finished with a thick layer of 18k gold, so it keeps its colour with everyday wear. Sizes J to S.
image_alt: Gold solitaire ring with an emerald-cut stone and pavé band

name: Waridi Halo Ring
short_description: A cushion-cut pink tourmaline framed by a halo of white stones, on a rose gold vermeil band.
description: Waridi (rose) centres an 8 mm cushion-cut pink tourmaline in a halo of small white sapphires, with more stones running down the shoulders. The band is sterling silver plated in 18k rose gold. Every tourmaline is a slightly different shade of pink.
material: 18k rose gold vermeil, pink tourmaline, white sapphire
image_alt: Rose gold ring with a pink cushion-cut stone and a halo of small diamonds

name: Simba Signet Ring
short_description: A heavy gold signet with a hand-engraved crest. Made to be worn every day and passed on.
description: The Simba signet has a 14 mm round face with a crest engraved by hand at our bench, and a band that tapers for comfort. It is cast in solid brass and plated in 18k gold. Ask us about engraving your own initials instead.
image_alt: Chunky gold signet ring with an engraved round face

name: Jua Halo Pendant
short_description: An open gold oval on a fine 45 cm chain. Light enough to wear alone or layer.
description: Jua (sun) is a 20 mm open oval with a soft polished finish, hung on a 45 cm snake chain with a 5 cm extender. It sits just below the collarbone and layers well with shorter chains.
image_alt: Gold necklace with an open oval pendant on a sandy textured surface

name: Bahari Pearl Strand
short_description: Freshwater pearls hand-knotted on silk. A classic strand for weddings and every day after.
description: Bahari (ocean) uses 7 to 8 mm freshwater pearls, each knotted by hand on silk so they never rub against each other. Length is 42 cm with a gold vermeil clasp. Each pearl is slightly different, which is how you know they are real.
material: Freshwater pearls, silk, 18k gold vermeil clasp

name: Mnyororo Rope Chain
short_description: A chunky twisted rope chain in gold vermeil that catches the light from every angle.
description: Mnyororo (chain) is a 4 mm twisted rope chain with a lobster clasp, in 45 cm or 50 cm. Wear it alone as a statement or add a pendant.
image_alt: Gold twisted rope chains piled on a white surface

name: Shaba Bold Hoops
short_description: Chunky, hollow gold hoops that look heavy but weigh almost nothing. Our signature earring.
description: Our signature hoops are 25 mm across and 6 mm thick, made hollow so they are light enough to wear all day. They close with a hinged click-top and come in a gift box.
image_alt: Pair of chunky gold hoop earrings on a white stand

name: Lulu Huggie Earrings
short_description: Small, sleek huggie hoops that sit close to the lobe. Easy to sleep and shower in.
description: Lulu huggies are 12 mm across with a smooth, rounded profile and a hinged closure. Made from sterling silver with a thick 18k gold layer, they are hypoallergenic and nickel free.
image_alt: Small gold huggie hoop earring on a white surface

name: Nyota Filigree Drops
short_description: Rose gold filigree spheres on fine hooks, inspired by the carved doors of Lamu.
description: Nyota (star) drops are 12 mm spheres of hand-twisted filigree wire on French hooks, inspired by the patterns carved into old Swahili doors on Lamu. They move as you do and weigh under 2 g each.
image_alt: Pair of rose gold filigree drop earrings on white cloth

name: Jina ID Bracelet
short_description: A fine gold chain with a curved ID bar, ready to engrave with a name or a date.
description: Jina (name) has a 25 mm curved bar on a fine cable chain, 16 cm with a 3 cm extender. We engrave up to 12 characters by hand at no extra cost; add your text at checkout.
image_alt: Delicate gold bracelet with a curved ID tag

name: Kito Charm Bracelet
short_description: A whisper-fine chain scattered with tiny gold charms. Stack two or three together.
description: Kito (gem) is a 1 mm chain set with small star, moon and bead charms that catch the light. It is 17 cm long with an extender, and stacks well with the Jina ID Bracelet.
image_alt: Three delicate gold charm bracelets on a white background

name: Pwani Link Bracelet
short_description: Bold oval links in polished gold vermeil, with a toggle clasp that is easy to close one-handed.
description: Pwani (coast) is made of 10 mm oval links joined by hand and finished with a polished toggle clasp. It is 18 cm long and sits loosely on the wrist.
image_alt: Gold oval link bracelet worn on a wrist
